evidence_description: Historical 2024 revision baseline preserved for longitudinal audit comparison; quarantined from active 2026 rule execution.
Governs neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) and functional electrical stimulation (FES) for upper/lower motor neuron rehabilitation.
Governs specialized wheelchair seating, tilt-in-space, dynamic recline, and custom contoured cushions based on specialty PT/OT seating evaluation.
Governs permanent implantable intrathecal or epidural pain pumps for chronic intractable malignant or non-malignant pain following successful preliminary opioid trial.
Governs invasive and non-invasive mechanical home ventilators (HCPCS E0465, E0466) for chronic respiratory failure, neuromuscular disorders, and severe COPD.
Governs bioengineered skin and soft tissue substitutes for chronic non-healing diabetic foot ulcers and venous stasis ulcers failing >= 4 weeks standard care.
Governs diaphragmatic pacing and phrenic nerve stimulation systems for high cervical spinal cord injury and congenital central hypoventilation syndrome.
Governs insertable cardiac monitors / implantable loop recorders for recurrent unexplained syncope, cryptogenic stroke, and suspected occult atrial fibrillation.
CMS Claims Processing Manual Chapter 20 establishes billing, certificate of medical necessity (CMN), rental-to-purchase rules, and warranty standards.
CMS State Operations Manual establishes hospital discharge planning standards, inpatient vs home DME delivery rules, and transfer requirements.
RESNA Position Paper establishes evidence-based clinical indications for power seat elevation devices to facilitate transfers and reach in wheelchair users.
CMS DMEPOS Quality Standards mandate supplier accreditation, product delivery confirmation, patient equipment training, and 24/7 emergency service.
